scope: counterexample showing positive arity is necessary for the recorded 0-1 law surface

counterexample.random_truth_value: P is true with probability 1/2 and false with probability 1/2
counterexample.probability: Pr[A_n models P] = 1/2 for every n
counterexample.limit: lim_n Pr[A_n models P] = 1/2 not in {0,1}

conclusion: The positive-arity condition is necessary unless 0-ary relation symbols are excluded or made deterministic.
boundaries: no 0-1 law claim for random 0-ary relation symbols
